company_brief.summary: Acme Robotics builds warehouse automation systems.
company_brief.what_they_do: Autonomous mobile robots and the fleet-orchestration software that coordinates them.

role.title: Backend Engineer
responsibilities: Own service reliability and on-call rotation

requirements.text: Comfort operating distributed systems in production

questions.prompt: Walk through how you would design a rate limiter for an internal API.
questions.answer_outline: Token bucket vs sliding window; where state lives; distributed coordination; failure modes.

questions.prompt: How would you coordinate 500 robots reporting position several times per second?
questions.answer_outline: Ingestion pipeline; backpressure; partitioning by zone; eventual vs strong consistency.

flashcards.front: What problem does a token-bucket rate limiter solve?
flashcards.back: It smooths bursty traffic by allowing a fixed refill rate with a burst allowance.
